answer: The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, revoked by a single upheld challenge, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. What survives to the ripple is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The meadow is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the jetty. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
